intro_line: A chaotic, charming riverside capital waking to a new airport.
intro: Phnom Penh rewards visitors with grand royal palaces, sobering history, and a buzzing riverside food scene. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: No metro or tram; the city bus network has 13 lines running about 05:30-20:30.
City bus fare is 1,500 riel per ride; drivers give no change, so pay exact.
Tuk-tuks cost about US$2-3 in town and US$8 to the airport; agree the fare first.
Ride apps PassApp, Grab and TADA work well and show fixed prices, so no haggling.
Motorbikes rent for US$5-6 a day; traffic is chaotic and theft is common, so park in guarded areas.
Cyclos and bicycles are slow but scenic; bike hire is US$1-3 a day.

airports.name: Techo International Airport
airports.note: New main airport since 9 Sep 2025; about 20 km from the centre, so allow extra time.

options.to: Kouch Kanong Roundabout via AEON Mall 3
options.note: Runs 05:30-23:30 every 10 min; pay exact, no change given.
App price is fixed; drivers may need help with pickup points.
Agree the fare first; show clean, untorn dollar notes before paying.
Cheaper but slow and exposed to traffic fumes.
